name: Daily Tarot
author: dar8mar

sections.description:
Create tarot decks and spreads, schedule daily publishing, and generate beautiful, Instagram-ready images for sharing your readings visually.

Perfect for:

  • Tarot readers & spiritual practitioners
  • Daily “Card of the Day” blogs
  • Coaches & healers
  • Content-driven tarot websites

Core features:

  • Daily tarot card publishing
  • Calendar-based scheduling
  • Decks & spreads management
  • Visual social sharing (Instagram-ready images)
  • Shortcodes & Gutenberg blocks

Highlights:

  • Calendar-driven publishing workflow
  • Decks + Meaning Packs
  • Spreads with presets and meaning packs
  • Visual sharing tools (image + caption)
  • Shortcodes + Gutenberg blocks
  • Backup, import, export tools
  • SEO: readable daily URLs + built-in sitemap + Yoast/Rank Math support
    [//]: # fs_premium_only_begin
  • Pro: Analytics + AI Integration + payment options
    [//]: # fs_premium_only_end

Free vs Pro:

Free includes:
* Calendar (edit today + tomorrow)
* Decks and Meaning Packs
* Spreads (scan + presets + meaning packs; free users can create one custom meaning pack)
* Shortcodes + Gutenberg blocks
* Bookings (requests, reading types, availability, emails)
* Feedback (admin-only)

[//]: # fs_premium_only_begin
Pro unlocks:
* AI Integration (experimental) + provider settings
* Analytics dashboard
* Calendar editing beyond tomorrow
* Booking payment options (PayPal/Stripe + pay before/after)
[//]: # fs_premium_only_end

This plugin bundles the Freemius SDK under vendor/freemius for licensing and updates.

Visual Instagram Sharing

Instagram does not support direct web sharing – so Daily Tarot uses a smarter approach.

Visitors can download a beautifully designed tarot image, copy a ready-to-use caption, and share manually on Instagram – fully compliant and user-friendly.

Quick start (5 minutes)

  1. Go to Daily Tarot -> Calendar and set today’s card.
  2. Create or import a deck (Daily Tarot -> Content -> Decks).
  3. Create or import a meaning pack (Daily Tarot -> Content -> Meaning Packs).
  4. Add a page and insert the shortcode [daily_tarot].
  5. (Optional) Enable readable routes and re-save permalinks.

SEO optimization

Daily Tarot includes built-in SEO helpers for its readable daily routes:

  • Readable routes: pretty URLs for daily pages and card pages
  • XML sitemap: dtarot-sitemap.xml (optionally dtarot-sitemap-index.xml)
  • robots.txt: automatically adds the Daily Tarot sitemap URL
  • Yoast / Rank Math integration: adds Daily Tarot sitemap into the SEO plugin index and sets canonical/OpenGraph on readable routes
  • JSON-LD schema: outputs Article JSON-LD on readable daily pages when no SEO plugin is active

Note: after enabling readable routes or upgrading, re-save permalinks (WP -> Settings -> Permalinks -> Save Changes) to refresh rewrite rules.

External services

This plugin uses Freemius (freemius.com) for licensing, billing, and delivering updates for the Pro version.

Depending on your settings and license status, the Freemius SDK may communicate with Freemius servers to perform actions such as license activation/validation, update checks, and account/checkout flows.

Freemius privacy policy: https://freemius.com/privacy/
Freemius terms: https://freemius.com/terms/

Shortcodes

Core shortcodes include:

  • [daily_tarot]
  • [dtarot_decks], [dtarot_deck]
  • [dtarot_card]
  • [dtarot_spread]
  • [dtarot_booking]
  • [dtarot_booking_button]
  • [dtarot_booking_teaser]
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate Daily Tarot in WordPress Admin -> Plugins.
  3. If the readable route is enabled/used, re-save permalinks once after activation.

[//]: # fs_premium_only_begin
4. To enable Pro features, purchase a license and activate it under Daily Tarot -> Settings -> Pro.
[//]: # fs_premium_only_end
sections.faq:
How do I start a daily card workflow?

Create a deck, add a meaning pack, then open Daily Tarot -> Calendar and set a card + text for each date.

Does Daily Tarot create posts automatically?

No. Daily Tarot stores your daily entries internally and renders them via shortcodes and readable routes. (Pro can unlock extra automation tools.)

Can I use the plugin without AI or analytics?

Yes. AI and analytics are Pro-only; the core daily tarot workflow works without them.

Why do I see warnings after installation?

Some notices are shown only to administrators for configuration and troubleshooting. They don’t affect visitors or site performance.

Why are my card URLs returning 404?

Re-save permalinks (WP -> Settings -> Permalinks -> Save Changes). This rebuilds rewrite rules.

What shortcodes should I start with?

Use [daily_tarot] on a page for the current day, and [dtarot_spread] to embed a spread.

Where do I manage bookings?

Go to Daily Tarot -> Bookings for requests and reading types. Booking settings live under Daily Tarot -> Settings -> Bookings.

Where do I get support?

Email dailytarothelp@gmail.com.
